```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)

data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```


## Problem 1
The `penguins` dataset contains measurements of penguins from three species: Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo. Important variables include `species`, `island`, `bill_length_mm`, `bill_depth_mm`, `flipper_length_mm`, `body_mass_g`, `sex`, and `year`. This dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns. The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 3)` mm.

```{r}
p <- ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, colour = species)) + geom_point()

p

ggsave("penguins_scatterplot.png", plot = p)
```
